primary.desc: A folding fan of ice slats. Hold for a barrage of ice darts (one every 0.18s) that leave a little off your aim and curve smoothly onto the foe your cursor is on (a foe away from your aim pulls on nothing: you aim): one hold is one burst: let go and it ends on three large darts that hit twice as hard, fly faster and reach further, then a 0.5s pause before the next. Eight on one foe Shatter them. While skating they fly as fast, thick beams that hit twice as hard and home in the same way.
